C0972.title: MOBA Player Griefing Highlights: Intentional Feeding and AFK in Ranked Matches
C0972.summary: A video compilation showcases various griefing behaviors in MOBA ranked matches, including intentional feeding and AFK. These actions directly reward opponents with kill bonuses, put the griefer's team at a disadvantage, and undermine game fairness and player experience.

references.title: Trolling Behavior Roundup, Intentional Throwing in Ranked Matches and Various Highlights - Bilibili
